tenderSchedule.title: INVITING TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL BIDS FOR ENGAGING CONSULTANTS/AGENCIES FOR CONDUCTING PRUDENCE CHECK OF CAPITAL EXPENDITURE OF KPTCL, ESCOMs AND HRECS IN THE STATE OF KARNATAKA, FOR FY25 AND FY26
tenderSchedule.description: INVITING TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL BIDS FOR ENGAGING CONSULTANTS/AGENCIES FOR CONDUCTING PRUDENCE CHECK OF CAPITAL EXPENDITURE OF KPTCL, ESCOMs AND HRECS IN THE STATE OF KARNATAKA, FOR FY25 AND FY26

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All General Conditions of Eligibility, Specifications, Terms and Conditions as per the tender/RFP document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be a registered company/firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Bidder should be a registered company/firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants/ Agencies shall be well acquainted with the regulatory environment in the power sector and functioning of the licensees, central or state regulatory Commissions or authorities and have experience in dealing with such similar matters

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants/Agencies must have done prudence check of Capital expenditure of any of the Transmission/ Distribution/ Generation Companies. Preference will be given to the Consultants having experience in conduct of Prudence check of capital expenditure of Power Transmission & Distribution licensees in India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants/Agencies should have adequate number of individuals with appropriate technical, financial and legal capability to undertake such tasks as per the scope of work provided to them considering various steps to be undertaken from the inception to the completion of the task within the time frame prescribed by the Commission

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants / Agencies should have, on their rolls, Graduates or Post Graduates in the relevant disciplines, and must possess expertise in particular field

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: No part of the work of Prudence check will be allowed to be carried out by the persons who are not on the rolls of the Consultants/Agencies and the awarded work will not be allowed to be undertaken by a third party on back to back agreement. For this purpose, a list of qualified personnel on their rolls, with full details of qualification and experience, shall be furnished in the prescribed Format

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants/Agencies should submit the details of the prudence checks, or post-commissioning analysis of completed, and commissioned projects, if any, conducted by them in the previous years along with the details of their current engagement. For this purpose, the Consultants/ Agencies must have completed the Prudence checks on at least two occasions

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultant/Agencies should give a brief methodology about their proposed approach to carry out the work involved and their preparedness to collect data, conduct physical inspection (which includes extensive travelling to distance places to visit the completed projects site)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidders shall furnish/ attach to their offer, all relevant documents duly signed by bidder (copy of work order/Purchase Order and work completion certificate) as a proof and in support of the above, by uploading on to e-procurement portal along with technical bid qualifying experience

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The annual Minimum Turnover of the bidder for any two years in the last five years shall be Rs.50.00 Lakhs for each year (i.e. from the financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26). The bidder shall furnish necessary proof in this regard, in the form of Annual Accounts i.e., certified Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss Accounts, duly audited and certified by a Chartered Accountant and income tax returns along with furnishing the copies of income tax returns for the same (if audited accounts are not available for FY2025-26, provisional Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet certified by the Charted Accountant may be furnished)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultants/Agencies from partnership firms/ companies, shall furnish copies of certificate of registration/ deeds/articles of association, as the case may be, as consultancy service firm along with details of PAN and GST registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents as per the tender document
